title: Atlas Geometry Error v1
description: Structural schema for a conceptual AtlasGeometryError. Maps to current AppError subclasses in backend/jewelmind/api/errors.py without renaming or breaking any of them. See docs/bible/07-atlas/147-geometry-error-model.md.

errorCode.description: Conceptual codes, none of which exist as literal strings in current code — see docs/bible/07-atlas/147-geometry-error-model.md for the mapping to the real MODEL_GENERATION_FAILED / STEP_EXPORT_FAILED / STL_EXPORT_FAILED / CAD_ENGINE_UNAVAILABLE AppError codes.

technicalCause.description: The underlying exception text, where safe to surface (never a raw stack trace to an external caller).
